name: Image Model Text Test
description: Six open image models, ten label jobs, three seeds: can they spell? Plus hard prompts and a speed test. Prompts, ComfyUI workflows, OCR scoring scripts and tests, the pre-registered rule, raw results, reduced grids. Krea 2, MOSS-Image, Qwen-Image-2.1, FIBO 2.0-dev, Qwen-Image-2512, FLUX 3 Image Klein. No weights.
